thread:
Maria Chen: FYI — Nectar Health wants to convert the POC to a 6‑month committed contract. They asked for 40% off hosted API pricing and proposed $120k upfront. Need deal-desk review. Key notes: latency-sensitive, will keep using hosted for now, expect steady usage after ramp.

Devin Patel: +1 on latency note. POC ran 3 weeks, p95 latency ok. Usage profile: pretty bursty during weekdays, ~30% prefix reuse. I can share the perf logs if needed.

Kevin (Deal Desk): 40% is outside our standard playbook. What's the list-dollar total for the 6 months at list price? Also need expected ARR, and are they asking for invoice credit or rate change? @maria please paste the quick calc.

Maria Chen: quick calc below (approx):
```
list_total_6mo = $180,000  # from current rate card + expected usage
customer_offer = $120,000  # what Nectar proposed
implied_discount = (1 - customer_offer / list_total_6mo) * 100  # ≈ 33%
```
They said 40% in their email but the numbers they quoted map to ~33% off. They want a single upfront invoice to hit their procurement window.

Kevin (Deal Desk): ok that helps. Policy: we can approve up to 25% at AE level for pilot->commit. 25-35% needs Deal Desk + Finance signoff. >35% needs CRO approval + written justification. Please add the procurement timeline and where the $$ will be capitalized.

Maria Chen: procurement needs PO by 2026-04-08 to meet their quarter. They want invoice net30. No capital purchase; it's operational expense on their side.

Sarah (Finance): Don’t forget revenue recognition implications for an upfront prepay. We'll need billing schedule + contact for PO. Margin at 35% discount is tight but doable for hosted. If you push >35% we need justification and a renewal at list with no additional credits.

Devin Patel: technical ask — could we include a short SLA (p99 latency target) in the SOW? Nectar said performance is a gating factor for rollout.

Kevin (Deal Desk): SLA asks are fine but standard: performance depends on model and shard. We can include a monitored p99 objective and rollback clause. Also recommend gating the deepest discount on a 30% usage floor after ramp.

Leo (CRO): I'll approve a one-time 35% concession with the following conditions:
- 6‑month prepaid commitment for $117,000 (35% off $180k list)
- Renewal will default to list price unless renegotiated 60 days before EoC
- Include monitored p99 objective in SOW; failure to meet perf gives customer a credit (capped) but does not change price during term
- No additional credits / professional services discounts allowed in this deal
- Legal to sign off on SOW and procurement terms

Sarah (Finance): noted. Billing ops: invoice net30 to the customer PO; record as deferred revenue and recognize monthly over term. Need legal entity name + billing contact before I can approve invoicing.

Maria Chen: copying the customer PO contact (they gave name + email in separate doc). I'll open an internal PRD with the SOW draft and add @legal for redlines.

Kevin (Deal Desk): discount-bot — created approval record ID DD-2026-042. Conditions: 35% one-time, CRO approved, finance signed, SOW with monitored p99, upfront prepay.

discount-bot: Approval recorded: DD-2026-042. Waiting on "Legal: SOW signoff" and "Finance: Billing contact confirmed" checkboxes.

Maria Chen: thank you all — I'll follow up with attachments and chase legal. Leaving this open until PO + signed SOW in hand. :thumbsup:

Devin Patel: I'll prepare the performance appendix for the SOW and share logs with Legal/Security for their review.

Kevin (Deal Desk): moving to "in progress" — update me when PO is attached. :white_check_mark:
